title: Line sketch: Cosmic Orbital Dance
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A large circle anchors the composition, encircled by smaller, and dots of varying sizes against a backdrop. Thin curved lines imply orbital paths and gentle motion across the flat, layered plane. The work uses bold, unmodulated color fields with crisp edges and minimal shading (derived from painting #106).
